name: melancholy
quote: This run of dreary weather fits my mood.
description: An extended period of sadness tinged with serious thoughtful reflection. Sometimes melancholy can come with bittersweet or nostalgic experiences.
alternateDefinitions: A severe bout of melancholy may be considered 'melancholia' -- a form of depression that may warrant professional assistance.
The 'Four Temperaments' personality profile defines a 'melancholic personality' that's only partly related to 'melancholy' as a standalone experience.
perceptions: Something about the world is making me feel sad but not scared.
It's making me reflect on various things.
examples: The Raven by Edgar Allan Poe
The long dark days of winter.

guidance.description: Having a down mood from time to time is entirely normal. After all, you probably won’t feel deliriously happy with life all the time. However, when you have the blues, it can be difficult to shake it off. The good news is you have plenty of choices of things you can do to lift that melancholy mood.

variations.name: wistfulness
variations.description: A feeling of reflective sadness brought about by something or someone gone or otherwise unattainable.
perceptions: I've lost something or missed an outcome I had wanted.
It's making me reflect on various things.
examples: Wishing it was possible to visit with your grandmother again.
Missing your collection that was burnt in the fire.

comparisons.description: 'Wistfulness' is a specific type of melancholy where the driver is a specific unattainable longing. 'Nostalgia' is a specific type of wistfulness that is driven by personal memories of better times

commentaries.quote: Melancholy is the happiness of being sad.
I began to understand that suffering and disappointments and melancholy are there not to vex us or cheapen us or deprive us of our dignity but to mature and transfigure us.
All changes are more or less tinged with melancholy, for what we are leaving behind is part of ourselves.
I can barely conceive of a type of beauty in which there is no Melancholy.
Depression is melancholy minus its charms.
We all feel wistfulness or regret about roads not taken.
